questions.question: Do you think working hard is more important than working smart?
questions.question_ar: العمل الشاق أهم من العمل الذكي؟

questions.question: Would you rather be your own boss or have an amazing mentor?
questions.question_ar: تفضّل تكون مدير نفسك ولا يكون عندك مرشد ملهم؟

questions.question: Do you think passion fades when you make it your job?
questions.question_ar: تحس الشغف يقل لما يتحول لوظيفة؟

questions.question: Would you rather build something that lasts or earn a lot quickly?
questions.question_ar: تبني شيء يدوم ولا تكسب كتير بسرعة؟

questions.question: Do you think luck plays a bigger role in success than people admit?
questions.question_ar: تحس الحظ له دور أكبر في النجاح من كلام الناس؟

questions.question: Would you rather have a job everyone respects or a job you love but no one understands?
questions.question_ar: تفضّل شغل يعجب الكل ولا شغل تحبه ومحدش فاهمه؟

questions.question: Do you think you could start a successful business today with the right idea?
questions.question_ar: تفتكر تقدر تبدأ مشروع ناجح اليوم لو عندك الفكرة الصح؟

questions.question: Would you rather lead a team of 5 great people or a team of 50 average people?
questions.question_ar: تفضّل تقود فريق من 5 مبدعين ولا 50 عاديين؟

questions.question: Do you think the concept of a dream job is realistic?
questions.question_ar: تفتكر فكرة "وظيفة الأحلام" واقعية؟

questions.question: Would you rather master one skill completely or be good at many skills?
questions.question_ar: تحترف مهارة واحدة تماماً ولا تكون جيد في مهارات كتير؟

questions.question: Do you think money is the main reason most people work?
questions.question_ar: تفتكر الفلوس هي السبب الرئيسي لشغل معظم الناس؟

questions.question: Would you rather have your work recognized after your death or be celebrated now?
questions.question_ar: تفضّل تقدير شغلك بعد وفاتك ولا الاحتفال بيك دلوقتي؟

questions.question: Do you think ambition can damage personal relationships?
questions.question_ar: تفتكر الطموح ممكن يضر العلاقات الشخصية؟

questions.question: Would you rather have a career that changes the world or one that gives you total freedom?
questions.question_ar: تفضّل مهنة تغيّر العالم ولا مهنة تديك حرية كاملة؟

questions.question: Do you think remote work makes people less productive?
questions.question_ar: تحس العمل عن بُعد يقلل من إنتاجية الناس؟

questions.question: Would you rather fail at something big or succeed at something small?
questions.question_ar: تفضّل تفشل في حاجة كبيرة ولا تنجح في حاجة صغيرة؟

questions.question: Do you think social media is important for career growth today?
questions.question_ar: تفتكر وسائل التواصل مهمة للنمو المهني اليوم؟

questions.question: Would you rather have a career that is emotionally fulfilling or financially rewarding?
questions.question_ar: تفضّل مهنة تحقق لك إرضاء نفسي ولا دخل ممتاز؟

questions.question: Do you think most successful people are where they are due to privilege?
questions.question_ar: تفتكر معظم الناجحين وصلوا بفضل الامتيازات؟

questions.question: Would you rather work 10 hours a day for 4 days or 8 hours a day for 5 days?
questions.question_ar: تفضّل تشتغل 10 ساعات في 4 أيام ولا 8 ساعات في 5 أيام؟

questions.question: Do you think you will achieve your biggest career goal?
questions.question_ar: تفتكر هتحقق أكبر هدف مهني عندك؟

questions.question: Do you think Messi is the greatest footballer of all time?
questions.question_ar: تفتكر ميسي هو الأعظم في تاريخ كورة القدم؟

questions.question: Would you rather watch a live match at the stadium or at home with friends?
questions.question_ar: تفضّل تشوف الماتش في الملعب ولا في البيت مع أصحابك؟

questions.question: Do you think money has ruined football?
questions.question_ar: تفتكر الفلوس خربت كورة القدم؟

questions.question: Would you rather your team win the league or the Champions League?
questions.question_ar: تفضّل فريقك يفوز بالدوري ولا بدوري الأبطال؟

questions.question: Do you think VAR has improved football?
questions.question_ar: تفتكر تقنية الـ VAR حسّنت كورة القدم؟

questions.question: Would you rather be the best player on a losing team or a squad player on a winning team?
questions.question_ar: تفضّل تكون أفضل لاعب في فريق خسران ولا بديل في فريق كسبان؟

questions.question: Do you think esports should be considered a real sport?
questions.question_ar: تفتكر الرياضات الإلكترونية تعتبر رياضة حقيقية؟

questions.question: Would you rather watch football or basketball?
questions.question_ar: تحب تتابع كورة قدم ولا كورة سلة؟

questions.question: Do you think athlete salaries are too high?
questions.question_ar: تفتكر رواتب اللاعبين مبالغ فيها؟

questions.question: Would you rather win an Olympic gold medal or a World Cup?
questions.question_ar: تفضّل تفوز بميدالية ذهبية أولمبية ولا بكأس العالم؟

questions.question: Do you think performance-enhancing drugs should be allowed in sports?
questions.question_ar: تفتكر المفروض يسمحوا بالمنشطات في الرياضة؟

questions.question: Would you rather be the greatest athlete of all time but unknown or average but globally famous?
questions.question_ar: تفضّل تكون الأعظم ومحدش يعرفك ولا لاعب عادي ومشهور جداً؟

questions.question: Do you think mental health should be talked about more in professional sports?
questions.question_ar: تفتكر لازم نتكلم أكثر عن الصحة النفسية في الرياضة؟

questions.question: Would you rather attend the Olympics or the FIFA World Cup?
questions.question_ar: تفضّل تحضر الأولمبياد ولا كأس العالم؟

questions.question: Do you think home advantage genuinely affects match outcomes?
questions.question_ar: تفتكر اللعب على أرضك بيأثر فعلياً على النتيجة؟

questions.question: Would you rather your country host the World Cup or win it?
questions.question_ar: تفضّل بلدك تستضيف كأس العالم ولا تفوز بيه؟

questions.question: Do you think female athletes deserve equal pay to male athletes?
questions.question_ar: تفتكر الرياضيات يستحقوا نفس رواتب الرجال؟

questions.question: Would you rather be a sprinter or a marathon runner?
questions.question_ar: تفضّل تكون عدّاء مسافات قصيرة ولا ماراثون؟

questions.question: Do you think referees have too much power in sports?
questions.question_ar: تفتكر الحكام عندهم سلطة زائدة عن اللزوم؟

questions.question: Would you rather play team sports or individual sports?
questions.question_ar: تفضّل تلعب رياضة جماعية ولا فردية؟

questions.question: Do you think sports build better character in young people?
questions.question_ar: هل تعتقد أن الرياضة تبني شخصية أفضل للشباب؟

questions.question: Would you rather be a coach or an athlete?
questions.question_ar: تفضل تكون مدرب ولا لاعب؟

questions.question: Do you think doping scandals have permanently damaged trust in athletics?
questions.question_ar: هل فضائح المنشطات دمرت ثقتنا في الرياضة للأبد؟

questions.question: Would you rather watch a close boring game or a high-scoring one-sided match?
questions.question_ar: تفضل مباراة متقاربة ومملة ولا مباراة أهدافها كثيرة ومن طرف واحد؟

questions.question: Do you think loyalty to a club still matters in modern football?
questions.question_ar: هل الولاء للنادي لسه موجود في كورة القدم اليوم؟

questions.question: Would you rather have speed or strength as a superpower in sport?
questions.question_ar: لو تقدر تختار قوة خارقة في الرياضة، تختار السرعة ولا القوة؟

questions.question: Do you think the offside rule should be simplified?
questions.question_ar: هل لازم نبسط قانون التسلل؟

questions.question: Would you rather break a world record or win a team championship?
questions.question_ar: تفضل تحطم رقم قياسي عالمي ولا تفوز ببطولة مع فريقك؟

questions.question: Do you think sports are more about talent or mentality?
questions.question_ar: الرياضة تعتمد أكثر على الموهبة ولا العقلية؟

questions.question: Would you rather retire at the top of your game early or play longer but decline gradually?
questions.question_ar: تفضل تعتزل وأنت في القمة ولا تكمل لعب حتى لو مستواك نزل؟
